# External Headers Needed

Download these single-header libraries and place them here:

1) cpp-httplib (`httplib.h`)
   Repo: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib
   File: `httplib.h` (place in this folder)

2) nlohmann/json (`json.hpp`)
   Repo: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
   File: `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp` — rename to `json.hpp` in this folder.
